details.method: Preserve already identity-bound provider usage independently of proposal acceptance; reject output without discarding known costs, and keep missing/unacknowledged usage unknown rather than estimating or retrying.
details.when: A trusted host observes provider usage with acknowledged thread/turn while a later proposal validation or terminal outcome fails.
details.counterexample: Early unacknowledged turn events, forced termination without durable response and incomplete late-event windows cannot prove billable totals; success-only samples bias comparisons.
details.trial_plan: At the next actual consumer integration, inject a bound failure and malformed output plus unacknowledged-turn negative control; assert durable failure receipt retains only known raw usage with no output authority and no new generation attempt. Verify exact consumer receipt, not observer-only unit output.
